subject: Security & VPC discovery — SOC 2 / Vendor SQ / Next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@acme-analytics.com>, Vendor Security <security@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-05-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap — Privacy & VPC questions

Hi Asha — thanks for the time on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2 / Compliance: You mentioned Acme has a SOC 2 Type II report in progress (expected Q3). Can you confirm current scope (CCPA/GDPR controls, PII handling) and whether you have an interim SOC 2 report or SOC 2 Type I we can review?
- Vendor Security Questionnaire (SSQ): You said procurement would share the initial SSQ. If you can send the baseline spreadsheet we’ll complete the technical sections and return within 48 hours.
- Private / VPC / On‑prem: We discussed options for network isolation (VPC peering, private endpoints) and an air‑gapped on‑prem package. Attaching our standard deployment diagram for the VPC option to help the security team map firewall rules and egress requirements.

Attachments: redwood-deployment-diagram-vpc.pdf (network ports, outbound IP ranges)

Suggested next steps:
1) Send the Acme SSQ (one spreadsheet) and any procurement portal link.
2) If helpful, schedule a 45m technical deep-dive with our infra/security PM and your security engineer — propose Wed 5/11 10am PT or Thu 5/12 1pm PT.
3) We’ll fill the SSQ and return with a short appendix describing our SOC2 controls mapping, encryption/KMS details, and data retention.

If those next steps look good, I’ll loop in Marissa from our compliance team to coordinate the SSQ turnaround and follow-up.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales (Security & Infra)
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Hi Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. 

Quick answers: 
- SOC 2: We are actively working toward SOC 2 Type II with an expected attestation in Q3 2028. We have a completed SOC 2 Type I (FY2027) and an internal controls summary I can share. Our scope includes data privacy, access controls, and change management; GDPR is covered for EU customers via standard contractual clauses and DPO oversight. HIPAA isn’t in scope for our main product line, but we have an isolated stack for healthcare pilots — we can discuss controls if that’s required.
- SSQ: Attached is the Acme initial vendor SSQ (Acme_Vendor_SQ_Initial.xlsx). Procurement will also open a vendor portal ticket by EOD.
- Private/VPC: We reviewed your diagram and the network ports look standard. For strict network isolation customers we offer a dedicated VPC with private endpoints and limited egress — we can share the architecture diagram and routing table snippet in the deep-dive. Air-gapped on‑prem is available as a paid add‑on and requires a separate deployment/ops SLA.

Next steps from our side: procurement will send portal invite (procurement@acme-analytics.com). Security will intake the diagram and send any detailed port/routing questions. Let’s lock the tech deep-dive — Wed 5/11 10am PT works for our infra lead.

1) We will complete the technical sections of the SSQ within 48 business hours after a short technical sync.
2) For the deep-dive (45m) let’s confirm Wed 5/11 10am PT. Agenda: quick intros (5m), network & deployment diagram walkthrough (20m), SOC2/controls mapping Q&A (15m), next actions (5m).
3) Can you confirm the contact from Acme security who will attend the deep-dive and if procurement has already opened the portal (ticket id)?
4) For air-gapped/on‑prem, please send any minimal infrastructure constraints (storage type, physical media ingress rules). We’ll surface an ops SLA and packaging notes after the meeting.

If that works I’ll schedule the calendar invite and include a short pre-read mapping SOC2 clauses to our controls.
